_comment: Copy this file to config/external_feeds.local.json and edit it.
The .local.json file is git-ignored and is the ONLY source of feed URLs:
nothing typed into the dashboard is ever fetched, and no URL found inside
a feed entry is ever followed.
declared_trust_class is YOUR label, not a verification. Writing
'official_feed' does not make this dashboard check that the feed belongs
to whoever it claims to. The label is stored with each entry and shown as
'configured by you' so it can never read as a fact this system checked.
configured_symbols records why you added the feed. It creates the only
association this system will claim: 'from a feed configured for AAPL'.
No entry is matched to a symbol by reading its text.
